note: Reviewed per-file provenance for world-scoped CDN delivery (tools/cdn/README.md). Each object is published only for its own world page, under assets<world>/<sha>.<ext>, and only after apply re-fetches its exact bytes from the public served URL. Nothing here is CC0 or enters the shared catalogue.

authorization.ref: team/lanes/t3-cdn2.md brief (release owner, 2026-10-16): Gene's default via the release owner
authorization.permits: CDN delivery of files the live site already serves publicly to a world, for that same world only, under its own world-scoped key. Never the shared catalogue or shared /assets/<sha> aliases. Rights, audience and reuse terms are unchanged.
authorization.whyWithinAuthority: Every object is a file the world page already requests and the public origin already serves to anyone; the CDN copy is byte-identical (SHA-256 checked at apply and in the browser), reachable only by its world page mapping, and its audience (anyone with the URL) is the same as the origin URL's.
authorization.reviewer: release owner (L1) confirms by running apply; recorded in the receipt

/w/mars.audience: public: anyone who opens the world page

/w/littlemartians.audience: public: anyone who opens the world page
